summary: MikiLab Pro v14 — end-to-end FRONTEND verification of the new Master modules (Recipe Thermal Master Flow, Optical QC via Claude Vision, B2B Orders + forecast, Carbon Footprint + energy cost, 3D Digital Twin + Smart Torque). All panels render, integrate with backend, and produce the expected data-testid nodes. Regression: panel-emergency shows emergency-idle, panel-autoplan shows autoplan textarea, Operator toggle opens 'Chi è in laboratorio?' modal. ZERO runtime pageerrors, ZERO ReactCurrentOwner errors after gate + admin login + localStorage flag.
critical_code_review_comments: RecipeThermalFlow.jsx: recompute effect runs on every parameter change via a 350ms debounce — good. However, `tri` is redefined every render and included in useCallback deps of recompute (transitively) which is currently harmless because debounce swallows it; not a bug but worth memoising `tri` for hook hygiene (same pattern flagged across many files by ESLint react-hooks/exhaustive-deps).

DigitalTwin.jsx: canvas click uses raycast against 6 boxes on a rotating group — hit is possible but users may miss on first click; consider adding an invisible larger bounding sphere per machine to improve hit tolerance (previously flagged in iter200, still applies).

OvenQC.jsx: file upload sends a data-URL image_base64. On a 1x1 pixel JPEG Claude correctly returned verdict 'attenzione'. No timeout guard around the LLM call — a slow Claude response leaves the button unusable for 30s+ with only a spinner; consider a client-side 45s timeout with retry.

B2BOrders.jsx: b2b-forecast card requires `forecast.factor` truthy — Open-Meteo/holiday endpoint currently returns factor=1.0 with empty notes when there are no orders, and the card still renders with '+0 kg · ×1'. Consider hiding when notes are all empty and delta is 0.
server.py still >12,800 lines — please modularise (flagged since iter197).
seed_data_creation: Added 1 B2B order (BarTest / Baguette / 100 pz / 300g) — total 30 kg — then deleted after verification. Ran carbon compute and oven-qc once with a tiny test JPEG.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fast path: use page.request.post for /api/admin-gate/verify + /api/auth/login (do NOT use page.evaluate window.fetch — it is patched by emergent-main.js and can throw 'Failed to fetch' before navigation). Then goto /, localStorage.setItem('mikilab_admin_unlocked','1'), reload with wait_until='domcontentloaded' (not networkidle because telemetry polls every 4s). For range sliders (tf-hydration_pct, tf-dough_temp_c, tf-flour_temp_c, tf-batch_kg) use the React-native setter pattern: Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set.call(el,'26') then dispatchEvent('input',bubbles:true) — a plain element.value=... will NOT trigger React onChange. Interlock triggers at flour_temp_c > 22°C (backend threshold). Twin canvas selection: hit rate ~30-50% due to rotation; brute-force by iterating a 7x5 grid of click points at 150ms intervals reliably hits a mesh. All 6 new modules pass v14 acceptance criteria.
rca of the issue: N/A — all features work as specified.
